title: Yellowed Springy Algerian Lamb Tagine
description: A traditional Algerian dish featuring lamb shanks, score-fat, and a blend of spices, cooked in a comal to create a tender and flavorful meal, perfect for special occasions.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large comal over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lamb shanks and cook until they are browned on all sides.
Add the cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Pour in the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
Remove the comal from the heat and let it cool slightly.
Serve the lamb shanks with the rich and flavorful sauce spooned over the top.
